name: Telegram
description: Send messages to a Telegram chat or channel via a bot.

providedTools.description: Send a message to a Telegram chat. To send a LIST of records, bind `report.rows` to the structured data and it is delivered as an aligned table — do not flatten a list into prose.

credentialFields.label: Bot Token
credentialFields.help: Create a bot with @BotFather on Telegram and paste its token.

_localNote: Studio can broker this. Only tools marked "local": true can be called — the rest are hosted-platform only.
